notes.title: There is very little left before a major update and the release of the game
Small question
notes.content:
Hi all!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41216245/fc79f7084b718e4f667fc678f157a01bb91c2235.jpg

It's been over a year since the game went into Early Access. During this period, there was little news from us, but now it is time to announce that:
1. The game moved to Unreal Engine 4,
2. Now the whole world will be in 3D,
3. Locations will become more detailed and interesting,
4. Hurricane gameplay will not go anywhere, but liters of blood and severed arms and legs will join it,
5. Improvement of the character, during the passage, you can upgrade the hero.

https://i.ibb.co/nBFfQSq/imacowboy.gif

Release very soon, thanks for your support and for staying with us all this time, you are the best! :)

notes.title: Added the ability to disable the dot effect in the game
notes.content:
During the game, press the number 1 button to turn off the dot effect
 Increased camera viewing distance

notes.title: Reworking levels and enemy AI
notes.content:
Improved levels
 Reworked enemy AI on several levels
 Improved AI of the first boss - machine gun
 Added boss life bar
 Changed mechanics of throwing dynamite - increased range, added rebound from walls

notes.title: Update from 01/18/2022
notes.content:
Added 2 levels
 Added a system for calculating player points, saving them and achieving them based on scoring
 Changed player collision mask
 Added Glitch effect
 Changes the point shader a bit
